messages:
nightly-eval-bot: :warning: nightly-eval alert for promptset 'instr-follow-v3' — failure rate jumped from 1.2% -> 9.7% in last run (2026-03-20 03:12 UTC). samples attached
Anya: saw this in the dashboard, digging into examples now. first glance: many responses are truncated mid-sentence or drop the system instruction.
Miguel: fyi we rolled tokenizer change and a small serving change in last night's release: commit abc123 (tokenizer: merge token-split V2). Could be related.
Sally: grabbed a before/after pair from the eval traces:
```
# before (good):
System: You are a helpful assistant.
User: Summarize the text.
Assistant: Sure, here's the summary...

# after (bad):
System: You are a helpful assi
User: Summarize the text.
Assistant: <short, incomplete response>
```
Sally: looks like the system prompt got truncated at the token boundary. Notice the space handling around "helpful" changed.
Raj: also seeing increased token counts for same inputs — tokenization shifted, pushes content over max_input_tokens -> upstream truncation in request normalization.
Anya: hypothesis: tokenizer V2 changed whitespace/token merges and our serving runtime has a max_input_tokens ceil that rounds down incorrectly. Net effect: system prompt trimmed, model no longer gets full instruction, so outputs degrade.
Miguel: confirming: tokenizer unit tests passed, but we didn't include the end-to-end prompt-preservation check that simulates full system+user bundles. my bad.
Anya: mitigation plan proposal:
1) Rollback tokenizer merge on hosted and dedicated immediately (Miguel) :arrow_right_hook: reduces impact.
2) Add canary routing of 5% to new tokenizer with enhanced promptset monitors for next iteration (Sally).
3) Add gating rule: any tokenizer/model runtime change must pass "prompt-preserve" suite (covers system/session bundling) before rollout (Raj).
4) Update nightly-eval to flag increases in truncation/early termination and fail CI if >2% regression (Anya).
5) Short-term patch: adjust max_input_tokens calculation to use floor vs ceil to avoid silent truncation (Miguel).

Miguel: starting rollback now. keeping 5% canary off until tests pass. :wrench:
ops-bot: rollback job started for service:tokenizer-service env:prod by Miguel at 2026-03-20T03:25:12Z
Sally: I'll run targeted promptset evals against a small sample of canary hosts after rollback completes.
Raj: I'll add the prompt-preserve test to the CI job and a pre-merge check. ETA EOD.
Anya: writing short RCA blurb for release notes and incident tracker: root cause = tokenizer token-splitting change + missing end-to-end prompt preservation test -> system prompt truncation -> degraded outputs. mitigation = immediate rollback, add canary + new CI gating, and revert max_input_tokens rounding.
ops-bot: rollback job finished successfully at 2026-03-20T03:48:40Z :white_check_mark:
Miguel: rollback successful in prod. monitoring now — failure rate back to 1.3% in next eval run.
Anya: thanks everyone. action items assigned in ticket RWD-ML-4823: Miguel (rollback + patch), Sally (canary test harness + eval dashboards), Raj (CI gating + tests), Anya (RCA writeup + postmortem). ETA for all fixes: 2026-03-25.
Sally: adding a quick smoke snippet to detect prompt truncation in the eval harness:
```
def prompt_preserve_check(system, user, tokenizer):
    tok_sys = tokenizer.encode(system)
    tok_all = tokenizer.encode(system + "\n" + user)
    assert len(tok_all) >= len(tok_sys) + 1
```
Anya: we'll also add metric: pct_inputs_with_system_truncation per model and break deployments if >0.5%.
Miguel: noted. creating canary config once tests green. :shipit:
